channel.title: Holistic Life: Healthy Meal Prep for Busy Weeks
channel.description: Healthy Meal Prep for Busy Weeks guides from Holistic Life.

item.title: Healthy Meal Prep for Busy Weeks: A 3-Part Formula That Always Works
item.description: Healthy meal prep for busy weeks starts with a simple formula. Choose a protein, a grain or starch and a vegetable, then cook once and mix and match all week. Three sample packs and food safety tips included. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gift Basket Ideas for Meal Preppers: Build a Packed Lunch Basket
item.description: Gift basket ideas for someone who packs lunch every day. Start with an insulated lunch bag, then add two locking containers, an ice pack and reusable cutlery. The guide has two more baskets to build and what to look for in each piece. Guide contains affiliate links.
